author: sjm41
body:
* **PTHR ID & PTN node:**
PTN000506667 (PTHR22731)

* **Sequences with problematic annotation (ID + gene/protein name):**
Dmel Pop1 (FBgn0026702)

* **Type of Issue: Erroneous source or erroneous propagation, or other issue**
Erroneous source

Pop1 is a non-catalytic subunit of the RNAse P and RNase MRP complexes. But via this node it gets "ribonuclease P activity(CONTRIBUTES_TO)" based on (YEAST|SGD=S000005165|UniProtKB=P41812) and (HUMAN|HGNC=30129|UniProtKB=Q99575;).

I've disputed the human annotations in P2GO.
@edwong57 you might want to review the SGD annotations.
title: PAINT issue: PTN000506667 (PTHR22731)

author: marcfeuermann
body: Another CONTRIBUTES_TO, this is a never ending story ;-) I removed the annotation and replaced by "protein complex scaffold activity".

author: sjm41
body: Might be an idea to systematically review all 'contributes to' MF annotations in PAINT/SGD if/when time allows....

author: marcfeuermann
body: That was the plan. But as you can imagine, with one priority taking precedence over another, the project ended up on the shelf ;-)
